the following issues: (i) the conceptualization of the terms competitiveness and technological capacity building, (ii) the methodological framework for the evaluation of these attributes and (iii) the application of the proposed method in a case study of a public policy.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed a conceptual framework for the evaluation of the competitiveness and technological capacity building of R&D projects, based on a set of indicators that are directly measurable and that can be applied to any incentive policy.

we have presented a methodological framework for the evaluation of R&D projects, based on a conceptual framework that allows the identification of different dimensions of the attributes "competitiveness and technological capacity building".

this paper provides a conceptual and methodological framework for the evaluation of the competitiveness and capacity building of R&D projects, which can be applied in the context of the Brazilian Informatics Policy and in the context of other policies that have similar characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the evaluation of the competitiveness and technological capacity building attributes of R&D projects is feasible, and that this evaluation is a necessary condition for a better understanding and management of the results of public policy.

the evaluation of R&D projects is a very complex and challenging task, requiring the use of a wide variety of indicators and the use of a conceptual and methodological framework that is consistent with the goals and the context of the evaluation.

the evaluation of R&D projects should not focus only on the results of the projects, but on the process of innovation and its impact on competitiveness and capacity building, in order to provide a more complete assessment.
